material_change: Recover the 48/48 successful V1 Q1_CURRENT and Q2_VARIANT response bodies through the preregistered DataCite DOI-to-arXiv alias bridge, discarding failed Q0 rather than imputing it.
identity_bridge: Use response arxiv_id when present; otherwise normalized DOI prefix 10.48550/arxiv.

arms.B0_RAW: first 20 unique arXiv identities from Q1_CURRENT (legacy result-key compatibility)
arms.B1_CURRENT: first 20 unique arXiv identities from Q2_VARIANT (legacy result-key compatibility)
arms.S1_RRF3: top 20 unique arXiv identities by reciprocal-rank fusion of Q1_CURRENT and Q2_VARIANT with k=60 (legacy result-key compatibility)

statistics.primary_metric: mean per-task official arXiv-id recall at candidate cap 20

gates.G1_TRANSPORT: all 48 admitted source calls ended HTTP 200
gates.G2_EMISSION: fused arm has any gold hit on at least 12 of 24 tasks and mean recall >= 0.20
gates.G3_FUSION: fused mean recall gain over strongest single view >= 0.05 and paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
gates.G4_NO_PRECISION_COLLAPSE: fused mean precision >= strongest single-view mean precision - 0.02

forbidden_claims: generality beyond the frozen 24-task development subset
